name: Steinbach (Taunus, Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of blue, yellow and blue with a broad yellow middle stripe, charged above the centre with the city arms of Steinbach (Taunus) (a blue well on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Steinbach (Taunus); German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
